services:
  meilisearch:
    image: getmeili/meilisearch:v1.26.0
    environment:
      - http_proxy
      - https_proxy
      - MEILI_MASTER_KEY=${MEILI_MASTER_KEY:-masterKey}
      - MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS=${MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS:-true}
      - MEILI_ENV=${MEILI_ENV:-development}
      - MEILI_LOG_LEVEL
      - MEILI_DB_PATH=${MEILI_DB_PATH:-/data.ms}
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - meilisearch.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  urbo-backend-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: pg_isready -U postgres
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 5s
    volumes:
      - ./create-databases.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/create-databases.sh
      - urbo-cms-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
      POSTGRES_DB: urbo
      POSTGRES_DB2: keycloak
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.4.0
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/9000;echo -e 'GET /health/ready HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n' >&3;if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo 'Healthcheck Successful';exit 0;else echo 'Healthcheck Failed';exit 1;fi;"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
      # A cold start does Quarkus augmentation, the Liquibase schema init and the realm import
      # before it is ready — measured at ~125s on a loaded laptop, which blew the old 30s+10x10s
      # budget by a hair. Failures during start_period do not count, and a success ends it
      # immediately, so a generous window costs a warm start nothing.
      start_period: 300s
    command: start-dev -Dkeycloak.profile.feature.upload_scripts=enabled --import-realm -Dkeycloak.migration.strategy=OVERWRITE_EXISTING
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    volumes:
      - ../../.urbo/${URBO_INSTANCE}/imports:/opt/keycloak/data/import
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "20m"
        max-file: "10"
    depends_on:
      mailpit:
        condition: service_started
      urbo-backend-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - keycloak.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}
    environment:
      KC_HOSTNAME: ${KC_HOSTNAME}
      KC_HOSTNAME_BACKCHANNEL_DYNAMIC: true
      KC_PROXY_HEADERS: xforwarded
      KC_DB: postgres
      KC_DB_URL: jdbc:postgresql://urbo-backend-postgres:5432/keycloak?characterEncoding=UTF-8
      KC_DB_USERNAME: postgres
      KC_DB_PASSWORD: postgres
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: admin
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      KC_HEALTH_ENABLED: "true"
      KC_LOG_LEVEL: info
      KC_HTTP_ENABLED: "true"

  mailpit:
    image: axllent/mailpit:v1.29.3
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - mailpit.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  sendinblue-api:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      mailpit:
        condition: service_started
    volumes:
      - ./sendinblue:/app:ro
    command: [ "python", "/app/sendinblue_mock.py" ]
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:1080/health')" ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 5s
    environment:
      PORT: 1080
      SMTP_HOST: mailpit
      SMTP_PORT: 1025
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
